_comment: Wave 101 — army-level focus fire (env-gated SWEG_FOCUSFIRE). This is an AI tactical heuristic, NOT a Warhammer 40,000 10th-edition game rule. There is no codex/core rule that forces an army to concentrate fire; focus fire is a player-level tactic. Following the precedent of simulator.squad_size_durability_factor (an explicitly-flagged AI design heuristic), the entry quotes the core Shooting-sequence target-selection wording that the heuristic operates within, and cites the real-world tactic and the project residual analysis that motivate it. The mechanic does NOT change combat math — it only re-points existing fire onto a target the firing army can already collectively destroy.

simulator.focus_fire.rule_name: Counter-brick focus fire (AI tactic, not a game rule)
simulator.focus_fire.quoted_text: Each time a unit is selected to shoot, you must select the target(s) for all of its ranged weapons before any are resolved.
simulator.focus_fire.trigger: Once per Shooting phase, per army (env-gated SWEG_FOCUSFIRE). The army identifies the most dangerous enemy 'brick' (a MONSTER / VEHICLE / TITANIC unit or any model with 8 or more wounds) that its still-to-activate units can destroy COLLECTIVELY this phase — the summed expected wounds from every unit able to wound it reach at least 0.85 of the brick's current wounds, with two or more contributing units. Each unit that can wound that brick then selects it as its shooting target, overriding the per-unit lowest-current-health picker. A unit that cannot wound the brick is never redirected (no wasted fire). Modelling motivation: docs/FACTION_RESIDUAL_ANALYSIS.md — opponents of Imperial Knights instrumented at 0.00 big Knights killed per game because every unit individually avoids the 26-wound brick no single unit cracks; the real counter-Knight tactic is to focus fire several units onto one Knight to cross its wound threshold.
simulator.focus_fire.effect: AI shooting target-selection heuristic. When the firing army can COLLECTIVELY destroy a high-threat enemy brick this Shooting phase, every unit that can wound it concentrates its fire on it instead of each unit independently picking the lowest-health enemy. This is an AI design heuristic, NOT a 10e rule — the quoted core wording (the target must be chosen for the whole unit before any weapon resolves) is the decision point the heuristic acts on; it does not alter any combat math, dice, or damage, it only changes which legal target the AI picks. Faithful and even-handed: it fires for ALL factions versus ANY crackable brick, and it does not fabricate damage — a genuinely uncrackable brick is never nominated, so no fire is wasted. Cross-references the real counter-Knight focus-fire principle (Goonhammer Imperial Knights faction focus) and docs/FACTION_RESIDUAL_ANALYSIS.md.
